title: Occupancy and Residency Certification: Pre-Return Window for a Mailed Certification
content:
The **pre-return window** applied to a mailed certification form on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile depends on the health-care absence check-ins recorded on the profile, compared with the form's signature date:

| Check-ins on the profile | Pre-return window |
|---|---|
| a check-in dated after the form's signature date is recorded | 14 days |
| check-ins are recorded, but none is dated after the signature date | 7 days |
| no check-in is recorded | zero days |

A check-in dated on the signature date itself is not dated after it.
